findings: Final v43 and v47 submission notebooks run vit4 then unet1024 and threshold at 0.5. unet5 is present in the repository but not invoked by these final notebook ensembles.
Temporal frames occupy quadrants 3,0 / 1,2; frame-level rotation and reflection precede assembly. Encoder features retain top-left quadrants for decoding.

Submission model averages eight spatial probabilities, clips and converts to logits, then applies learned asymmetric convolution. vit4 accepts a none configuration but its forward still performs all eight transforms.
Final training configs use MaxViT tiny features and branch-specific decoder channels, weight decay and schedule. Full encoder/decoder, training losses, fold/ensemble semantics remain to validate.
next_action: Implement and validate the actual two-branch final lifecycle; inspect prediction weighting and training loops before graph publication.
